Alt (c): $y=\sqrt3\frac{\tan t\pm\tan\frac{\pi}{3}}{1\pm\tan t\tan\frac{\pi}{3}}$ M1
$\left(\Rightarrow y(1\pm\sqrt3\tan t)=\sqrt3\tan t\pm3\Rightarrow\tan t=\frac{\pm y\pm3}{\pm y\sqrt3\pm\sqrt3}\right)$
$x^2=\sec^2t=1+\tan^2t=1+\left(\frac{y-3}{\sqrt3(y+1)}\right)^2$ M1 A1
$\Rightarrow3x^2-3=\left(\frac{y-3}{y+1}\right)^2\Rightarrow\frac{y-3}{y+1}=\sqrt{3x^2-3}\left(\text{as }y<-1\Rightarrow\frac{y-3}{y+1}>0\right)$
$\Rightarrow y=\frac{3+\sqrt{3x^2-3}}{1-\sqrt{3x^2-3}}=\frac{(3+\sqrt{3x^2-3})(1+\sqrt{3x^2-3})}{1-3x^2+3}=\frac{...x^2+...\sqrt{3x^2-3}}{4-3x^2}$ M1
$=\frac{3x^2+4\sqrt{3x^2-3}}{4-3x^2}$ A1
